# Pesher Habakkuk Column 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 6 | **Condition:** Well preserved with minor damage at top

---

**6:1** "'And-You-made men like-the-fish-of the-sea,

**6:2** like-creeping-things with-no-one to-rule

**6:3** them. All-of-them he-brings-up with-a-hook;

**6:4** he-drags-them in-his-net and-gathers-them in-his-seine;

**6:5** therefore he-rejoices and-is-glad' (Hab 1:14-15)."

**6:6** Its pesher: [...] the-Kittim, who

**6:7** gather their-wealth together-with all their-plunder

**6:8** like-the-fish-of the-sea.

**6:9** "Therefore he-sacrifices to-his-net

**6:10** and-burns-incense to-his-seine,

**6:11** for by-them his-portion is-fat

**6:12** and-his-food is-rich" (Hab 1:16).

**6:13** Its pesher: they sacrifice to-their-standards

**6:14** and-their weapons-of-war are their-objects-of-worship.

**6:15** "For by-them [their-portion] is fat

**6:16** and their-food is rich" — its pesher:

**6:17** they divide their-yoke and-their-tribute-tax, their-food, upon-all the-peoples year by year, laying-waste many lands.

---
*EMET notes: Column 6 covers Hab 1:14-16. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
